summary.zh: 通过可视化讲解理解语言模型、语义搜索与应用设计。适合建立基础概念后结合项目阅读。
summary.en: Visual explanations of language models, semantic search and application design. Read alongside a project after establishing basic concepts.

author: Aston Zhang, Zachary C. Lipton, Mu Li, Alexander J. Smola

summary.zh: 用可运行示例补齐深度学习基础。无需先通读全书，可按项目需要查阅注意力机制和 Transformer 等主题。
summary.en: Build deep learning fundamentals with executable examples. Consult attention and Transformer chapters as needed; reading cover to cover is not a prerequisite.
